scope: Factual ownership and policy precedence for universal human-first guidance versus specialist-domain templates.
a7_owns: Global stable identities and module/fact-class authority routing
Public service discovery and accessible operator-guide design suggestions
Shared non-domain-specific interaction vocabulary when adopted by owners
a7_does_not_own: CAD/AAD drawing template, geometry/schema and engineering execution
R&D LaTeX and PPTX formatting/generator controls
Structural member checks, Scheduling activities, Cost rate/BOQ formulae, Operations site evidence
Private Drive/A9 Main/Local normative bytes, registry state or release approvals
mandatory_navigation: A7 may index owner, route, version, public URL and source observation. No editing peer repositories without a separately scoped user mandate.
compatibility: The seven-stage A7 v0.1 example is historical guidance, not a global implementation mandate. CAD's source-owned UNDERSTAND→RESOLVE→VALIDATE→EXECUTE→VERIFY→VIEW→TRACE is CAD's active domain flow.
source_truth: GitHub owner contracts and owning provider sources verified independently. User prompts and this public registry cannot make domain approvals.
private_a9: A7-SEQ-000013 remains staged; private Main/Local bridge not imported or ACKed.
